verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a mail-management SaaS with an API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented bulk or batch action. The API covers searching and retrieving MailItems and creating Locations one at a time, and the company endpoint is explicitly 'Creates a single company'. List endpoints and auto-routing rules are adjacent features, not bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
